items.title: Deep-Reporter: Deep Research for Grounded Multimodal Long-Form Generation
items.title_zh: Deep-Reporter：面向有据可依的多模态长文生成的深度研究
items.summary: Deep-Reporter is a unified agentic framework for grounded multimodal long-form generation that combines agentic multimodal search and filtering, checklist-guided incremental synthesis and recurrent context management, trained on 8K curated agentic traces. The authors also introduce M2LongBench, 247 research tasks across nine domains in a stable multimodal sandbox, and find that post-training can narrow the gap on this difficult task.

items.title: State-of-the-Art Arabic Language Modeling with Sparse MoE Fine-Tuning and Chain-of-Thought Distillation
items.title_zh: Arabic-DeepSeek-R1：稀疏 MoE 微调与思维链蒸馏驱动的阿拉伯语 SOTA 建模
items.summary: Arabic-DeepSeek-R1 fine-tunes a sparse MoE backbone with a four-phase chain-of-thought distillation scheme and a 372M-token, contamination-controlled 80/20 Arabic-English mixture. The authors report the highest average score across the seven-benchmark Open Arabic LLM Leaderboard and state-of-the-art or near-state-of-the-art results on MadinahQA, AraTrust, AlGhafa and ALRAGE, outperforming GPT-5.1 on the majority of evaluated benchmarks.

items.title: DeepTutor: Towards Agentic Personalized Tutoring
items.title_zh: DeepTutor：迈向智能体个性化辅导
items.summary: DeepTutor is a fully open-source agentic framework that unifies citation-grounded tutoring with difficulty-calibrated question generation, using a hybrid personalization engine that couples static knowledge grounding with dynamic learner memory. The authors introduce TutorBench and report average gains of 10.8% on personalized metrics plus 29.4% stronger general agentic reasoning across five backbone models.

items.title: ClawsBench: Evaluating Capability and Safety of LLM Productivity Agents in Simulated Workspaces
items.title_zh: ClawsBench：在模拟工作区中评估 LLM 生产力智能体的能力与安全性
items.summary: ClawsBench provides five high-fidelity mock services and 44 tasks spanning single-service, cross-service and safety-critical productivity workflows, with deterministic snapshot and restore. Across 6 models, 4 agent harnesses and 33 conditions, agents reach 39–64% task success but show unsafe action rates of 7–33%, and the authors identify eight recurring unsafe-behavior patterns including multi-step sandbox escalation.

items.title: Graph Query Generation with Constraint-guided Large Language Agents
items.title_zh: 约束引导大语言智能体的图查询生成
items.summary: UniQGen uses LLM agents to extract and refine graph query clauses into executable Cypher, extending Chase & Backchase with dynamic constraint reasoning and query-quality estimation. On a Cypher-supported Freebase graph deployed on Amazon Neptune it outperforms prior graph-query generation methods with F1 gains of 31.6% on GraphQ and 4.9% on GrailQA without fine-tuning for schema matching.

items.title: $π^2$: Structure-Originated Reasoning Data Improves Long-Context Reasoning Ability of Large Language Models
items.title_zh: $π^2$：源于结构的推理数据提升大语言模型长上下文推理能力
items.summary: The π² pipeline extracts and expands Wikipedia tables, generates complex questions whose answers are validated through dual-path code execution, and back-translates chain-of-thought solutions grounded in realistic context. Supervised fine-tuning of gpt-oss-20b and Qwen3-4B-Instruct-2507 on the data yields average absolute accuracy gains of 6.25% and 3.37% across four long-context reasoning benchmarks and π²-Bench, with code, data and models released openly.

items.title: Exemplar Retrieval Without Overhypothesis Induction: Limits of Distributional Sequence Learning in Early Word Learning
items.title_zh: 无需过度假设归纳的样例检索：早期词汇学习中分布序列学习的局限
items.summary: Autoregressive transformers trained on synthetic corpora achieved perfect first-order exemplar retrieval but only chance-level second-order generalization of 50–52% across 120 pre-registered runs. A feature-swap diagnostic indicated the models relied on frame-to-feature template matching rather than structured noun-to-domain-to-feature abstraction.

items.title: DataSTORM: Deep Research on Large-Scale Databases using Exploratory Data Analysis and Data Storytelling
items.title_zh: DataSTORM：基于探索性数据分析与数据叙事的超大规模数据库深度研究
items.summary: DataSTORM reframes deep research over structured databases as a thesis-driven process of discovering candidate theses, validating them through iterative cross-source investigation and developing coherent analytical narratives. It reaches a new state of the art on InsightBench with a 19.4% relative improvement in insight-level recall and 7.2% in summary-level score, and outperforms ChatGPT Deep Research on a new ACLED-based dataset in automated and human evaluations.

items.title: Toward a universal foundation model for graph-structured data
items.title_zh: 迈向图结构数据的通用基础模型
items.summary: The authors pretrain a feature-agnostic graph foundation model on heterogeneous graphs by encoding degree, centrality, community and diffusion signatures as structural prompts for a message-passing backbone. The pretrained model matches or exceeds strong supervised baselines and transfers zero-shot or few-shot to held-out graphs, reaching 95.5% mean ROC-AUC on SagePPI after supervised fine-tuning, a 21.8% gain over the best supervised message-passing baseline.

items.title: Efficient and Effective Internal Memory Retrieval for LLM-Based Healthcare Prediction
items.title_zh: 面向 LLM 医疗预测的高效内部记忆检索
items.summary: Keys to Knowledge replaces external retrieval in LLM-based healthcare prediction with key-based access to clinical information encoded in the model's parameter space, so retrieval adds no inference-time overhead. Activation-guided probe construction and cross-attention reranking improve retrieval quality, and the method reports state-of-the-art results on four healthcare outcome prediction benchmarks.

items.title: PRIME: Training Free Proactive Reasoning via Iterative Memory Evolution for User-Centric Agent
items.title_zh: PRIME：通过迭代记忆演化实现免训练主动推理
items.summary: PRIME is a gradient-free framework that distills multi-turn interaction trajectories into human-readable experiences covering successful strategies, failure patterns and user preferences, then retrieves them to guide later behavior. The authors report performance competitive with gradient-based methods while being cheaper and more interpretable.

items.title: ExecTune: Effective Steering of Black-Box LLMs with Guide Models
items.title_zh: ExecTune：用引导模型有效操控黑盒 LLM
items.summary: ExecTune trains a guide model to produce structured strategies that a black-box core model executes, optimizing executability through teacher-guided acceptance sampling, supervised fine-tuning and structure-aware reinforcement learning. Across math and code benchmarks it improves accuracy by up to 9.2% over prior state of the art while cutting inference cost by up to 22.4%, enabling Claude Haiku 3.5 to outperform Sonnet 3.5 and come within 1.7 points of Sonnet 4 at 38% lower cost.

items.title: Controllable and Verifiable Tool-Use Data Synthesis for Agentic Reinforcement Learning
items.title_zh: 面向智能体强化学习的可控可验证工具使用数据合成
items.summary: COVERT first generates validated base tool-use trajectories through self-evolving synthesis, then applies oracle-preserving augmentations that add distractor tools, ambiguous queries and noisy or erroneous tool outputs while keeping ground-truth calls and answers fixed. On Qwen2.5-Instruct-14B, COVERT-RL raises BFCL v3 accuracy from 56.5 to 59.9 and ACEBench from 53.0 to 59.3, and stacked on SFT reaches 62.1 and 61.8.

items.title: Is There Knowledge Left to Extract? Evidence of Fragility in Medically Fine-Tuned Vision-Language Models
items.title_zh: 还有知识可提取吗？医学微调视觉语言模型脆弱性的证据
items.summary: Evaluating four paired open-source VLMs across four medical imaging tasks, the authors find performance degrades toward near-random as task difficulty rises, with no consistent advantage from medical fine-tuning and high sensitivity to prompt formulation. A description-based pipeline that feeds model-generated image descriptions to GPT-5.1 recovers only limited additional signal, and embedding analysis traces failures to both weak visual representations and downstream reasoning.

items.title: AITP: Traffic Accident Responsibility Allocation via Multimodal Large Language Models
items.title_zh: AITP：基于多模态大语言模型的交通事故责任划分
items.summary: AITP is a multimodal LLM for traffic accident responsibility allocation that combines multimodal chain-of-thought reasoning with retrieval-augmented generation over traffic regulations, and the authors release DecaTARA, a ten-task benchmark with 67,941 annotated videos and 195,821 question-answer pairs. It reports state-of-the-art results on responsibility allocation, accident detection and accident understanding.

items.title: Think in Sentences: Explicit Sentence Boundaries Enhance Language Model's Capabilities
items.title_zh: 以句子思考：显式句子边界增强语言模型能力
items.summary: The paper inserts delimiters at sentence boundaries in LLM inputs, combining dummy-token insertion with sentence-by-sentence processing during reasoning, and tests in-context learning and supervised fine-tuning from 7B models up to 600B DeepSeek-V3. It reports consistent gains, including up to 7.7% on GSM8K and 12.5% on DROP, and finds sentence awareness reflected in the fine-tuned models' internal representations.

items.title: Verify Before You Fix: Agentic Execution Grounding for Trustworthy Cross-Language Code Analysis
items.title_zh: 先验证再修复：面向可信跨语言代码分析的智能体执行锚定
items.summary: The framework runs hybrid structural-semantic detection, execution-grounded agentic validation and validation-aware iterative repair under an invariant that no repair occurs without execution-based confirmation of exploitability, using a universal AST plus fused GraphSAGE and Qwen2.5-Coder embeddings. It reports 89.84-92.02% intra-language detection accuracy, 74.43-80.12% zero-shot cross-language F1 and 69.74% end-to-end vulnerability resolution.

items.title: Attribution Bias in Large Language Models
items.title_zh: 大语言模型中的署名归因偏差
items.summary: AttriBench balances author fame and demographics to test quote attribution across 11 widely used LLMs, finding large systematic accuracy disparities between race, gender and intersectional groups even for frontier models. The authors also document suppression, a failure mode in which models omit attribution entirely despite having access to authorship information, and find it unevenly distributed across demographic groups.

items.title: RAG or Learning? Understanding the Limits of LLM Adaptation under Continuous Knowledge Drift in the Real World
items.title_zh: RAG 还是学习？理解持续知识漂移下 LLM 适应的局限
items.summary: The authors build a benchmark of real-world dynamic events from time-stamped evidence to test how LLMs adapt as facts and entities change, finding that vanilla RAG and several learning-based methods suffer catastrophic forgetting and temporal inconsistency. They propose Chronos, a time-aware retrieval baseline that progressively organizes retrieved evidence into an Event Evolution Graph without additional training.

items.title: Paper Circle: An Open-source Multi-agent Research Discovery and Analysis Framework
items.title_zh: Paper Circle：开源多智能体科研发现与分析框架
items.summary: Paper Circle combines a discovery pipeline that merges offline and online retrieval, multi-criteria scoring and diversity-aware ranking with an analysis pipeline that converts papers into typed knowledge graphs of concepts, methods, experiments and figures. Both pipelines run in a coder-LLM multi-agent framework and emit reproducible JSON, CSV, BibTeX, Markdown and HTML at each agent step, and the authors report consistent retrieval and review-generation gains with stronger agent models.

items.title: A Statistical Framework for Auditing Behavioral Dependence and Induced Bias in LLM Judges
items.title_zh: 审计 LLM 评判器行为依赖与诱导偏差的统计框架
items.summary: The authors introduce a statistical framework for auditing hidden behavioral entanglement among black-box LLMs that can arise from shared pretraining data, distillation or alignment and can undermine LLM-as-a-judge and ensemble verification. Across 18 models from six families they find significant entanglement associated with judge over-endorsement bias, and show that de-entangled verifier reweighting beats majority voting in accuracy and precision.

items.title: Enabling Intrinsic Reasoning over Dense Geospatial Embeddings with DFR-Gemma
items.title_zh: 让 LLM 直接推理稠密地理空间嵌入：DFR-Gemma
items.summary: DFR-Gemma aligns high-dimensional geospatial embeddings with an LLM's latent space through a lightweight projector, injecting them as semantic tokens alongside natural-language instructions instead of converting them to text. The authors report accurate zero-shot reasoning on feature querying, comparison and semantic description tasks while improving efficiency over text-based baselines.

items.title: When Should a Language Model Trust Itself? Same-Model Self-Verification as a Conditional Confidence Signal
items.title_zh: 语言模型何时应信任自己？同模型自验证作为条件置信信号
items.summary: The study compares same-model self-verification against likelihood-based baselines LL-AVG and LL-SUM on ARC-Challenge and TruthfulQA-MC across model families, scales and prompt variants, measuring correctness ranking and abstention quality. It finds the signal is task- and model-dependent: helpful for Phi-2 and Qwen models on ARC-Challenge, but unreliable on TruthfulQA-MC, where LL-SUM often remains the stronger practical baseline.

items.title: STaR-DRO: Stateful Tsallis Reweighting for Group-Robust Structured Prediction
items.title_zh: STaR-DRO：面向群体鲁棒结构化预测的状态化 Tsallis 重加权
items.summary: The paper combines a modular prompt architecture—XML-style structure, expert rules, chain-of-thought, schema contracts and a self-validation gate—with STaR-DRO, a group-robust reweighting method that upweights only persistently hard groups. On the EPPC Miner clinical structured-prediction task, prompt engineering adds 14.46 label F1 and 17.40 span F1 on average across 1B–70B Llama models, and STaR-DRO further improves accuracy while reducing mean groupwise validation cross-entropy by 21.3% and 14.8% relative to SFT and standard DRO.

items.title: EE-MCP: Self-Evolving MCP-GUI Agents via Automated Environment Generation and Experience Learning
items.title_zh: EE-MCP：通过自动环境生成与经验学习自我进化的 MCP-GUI 智能体
items.summary: EE-MCP formulates the interplay between MCP API calls and GUI interaction as hybrid policy learning and builds an automatic pipeline for environment generation, trajectory collection, gap-driven task synthesis and quality-filtered training. An experience bank accumulates LLM-learned rules from trajectory comparisons for inference-time improvement without fine-tuning; across three desktop applications, distillation reaches a 77.8% pass rate on MCP-dominant tasks while the experience bank gains 10.0 points on GUI-intensive tasks.

items.title: Reading Human Preference from Looped Transformer Internal States
items.title_zh: 从循环 Transformer 内部状态读取人类偏好
items.summary: On Ouro-2.6B-Thinking and Anthropic's HH-RLHF data, a linear probe on hidden states identifies the preferred reply 61.5% of the time and a small nonlinear scorer reaches 64.9%, clearly above simple rules such as picking the longer reply but still weak. The study finds only a 0.7-point estimated edge for reading both replies together over scoring each separately, leaving open whether preference is stored as a comparison or as a per-reply property.

items.title: FashionMV: Product-Level Composed Image Retrieval with Multi-View Fashion Data
items.title_zh: FashionMV：面向多视角时尚数据的产品级组合图像检索
items.summary: FashionMV defines a multi-view composed image retrieval task and releases a dataset with 127K products, 472K multi-view images and over 220K CIR triplets built through an automated multimodal pipeline. Its ProCIR framework combines two-stage dialogue, caption-based alignment and chain-of-thought guidance, and a 0.8B-parameter model outperforms baselines including general-purpose embedding models ten times larger.

items.title: CheeseBench: Evaluating Large Language Models on Rodent Behavioral Neuroscience Paradigms
items.title_zh: CheeseBench：在啮齿动物行为神经科学范式中评估大语言模型
items.summary: CheeseBench evaluates six open-weight LLMs on nine rodent behavioral neuroscience paradigms rendered as ASCII text, with the best model reaching 52.6% average success versus 32.1% for random agents and 78.9% for approximate rodent baselines. It finds diminishing returns beyond 7B parameters, that longer context history and chain-of-thought prompting hurt, and that performance ranges from 20% to 57% depending on interface parameters alone.

items.title: Specialty-Specific Medical Language Model for Immune-Mediated Diseases
items.title_zh: 面向免疫介导疾病的专科医学语言模型
items.summary: The authors manually annotated 371 case reports with two clinical specialists across twelve entity classes and compared NER strategies for immune-mediated and infectious disease text. A transformer trained on clinical-domain embeddings reached an F1 of 0.89, outperforming baselines and zero-shot systems, while a prompted LLM baseline performed substantially worse on span-consistent entity boundaries.

items.title: FailproofAI/failproofai
items.title_zh: FailproofAI/failproofai：AI 智能体框架的可观测性与策略执行
items.summary: FailproofAI is a TypeScript toolkit that adds observability and policy enforcement to AI agent harnesses, capturing every run to support runtime reliability.

items.title: AgriciDaniel/claude-obsidian
items.title_zh: AgriciDaniel/claude-obsidian：基于 Obsidian 与 Claude Code 的自组织第二大脑
items.summary: Claude Obsidian is a Python-based, self-organizing second brain for Obsidian and Claude Code that reads, links and files dropped sources into a connected Markdown knowledge graph. It follows Karpathy's LLM Wiki pattern.

items.title: nashsu/llm_wiki
items.title_zh: nashsu/llm_wiki：把文档变成持久化知识 Wiki
items.summary: LLM Wiki is a TypeScript desktop application that turns documents into an interlinked knowledge base in which the model incrementally builds and maintains a persistent wiki. It contrasts with traditional RAG by avoiding re-retrieval from scratch for each query.

items.title: PKU-DAIR/AutoSci
items.title_zh: AutoSci：以 Wiki 为中心的全生命周期 AI 研究平台
items.summary: AutoSci is a Python, wiki-centric platform for the full AI research lifecycle, built on Claude Code. Its authors describe it as realizing Karpathy's LLM-Wiki vision.

items.title: llm-as-a-verifier/llm-as-a-verifier
items.title_zh: llm-as-a-verifier：无需额外训练的通用 Agent 验证框架
items.summary: LLM-as-a-Verifier is a Python framework that provides fine-grained feedback for any agent without additional training. Its authors report state-of-the-art results on coding, robotics and medical agentic benchmarks.

items.title: VILA-Lab/Dive-into-Claude-Code
items.title_zh: VILA-Lab/Dive-into-Claude-Code：Claude Code 系统分析
items.summary: The repository collects a structured study of Claude Code, intended to inform the design of current and future AI agent systems.

items.title: axoviq-ai/synthadoc
items.title_zh: axoviq-ai/synthadoc：LLM 知识编译引擎
items.summary: synthadoc is an open-source Python engine that compiles raw documents into structured, local-first wikis, positioned as a transparent, human-readable alternative to traditional RAG.

items.title: EKKOLearnAI/ekko-studio
items.title_zh: EKKOLearnAI/ekko-studio：本地优先多 agent 工作台
items.summary: Ekko Studio is a local-first workspace that combines multi-agent chat, coding and visual workflows across desktop and web.

items.title: Apr 8, 2026 Engineering Engineering Insights: Failure Modes That Break VLM-Powered OCR in Production Read
items.title_zh: 工程洞察：生产环境中破坏 VLM OCR 的失败模式
items.summary: LlamaIndex's engineering post examines failure modes that break vision-language-model-powered OCR in production.

items.title: Apr 9, 2026 Product Beyond Raw Text: How LlamaParse and LiteParse Give Agents Real Document Understanding Read
items.title_zh: 超越原始文本：LlamaParse 与 LiteParse 如何赋予智能体真正的文档理解
items.summary: LlamaIndex's product post describes how LlamaParse and LiteParse give agents document understanding beyond raw text extraction.

items.title: Exploiting the most prominent AI agent benchmarks
items.title_zh: 攻破主流 AI agent 基准测试
items.summary: Researchers at Berkeley RDI describe how their agent hacked every major AI agent benchmark, and discuss what the field needs to fix in how benchmark scores are trusted.
